gaps.sentence: British houses usually have gardens, ___ flats in Spain often have balconies.
The drug is remarkably effective. ___, it has almost no side effects.
gaps.explanation: 'Furthermore' introduces an additional point supporting the same claim.
'Firstly' opens a sequence of instructions; eventually/finally close one.

gaps.sentence: ___ the theory is elegant, the data simply don't support it.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' grants the fact (the theory is elegant) before contradicting it.

gaps.sentence: ___ had we sat down than the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner' pairs with 'than'; hardly/scarcely pair with 'when'.

gaps.sentence: ___ a staffing shortage, the clinic closed early.
gaps.explanation: 'Due to + noun phrase' states the cause in formal register.

gaps.sentence: She kept every receipt ___ she could claim the expenses back.
gaps.explanation: 'So that + could' expresses purpose; 'in case' expresses precaution.

gaps.sentence: He was warned repeatedly; ___, he ignored every safety rule.
gaps.explanation: He ignored the warnings despite receiving them: nevertheless marks that contrast.
